attribution.note: Zitron states and endorses the assessment in his own voice.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the asserted current inefficiency and lack of substantive efficiency effort. No condition or forecast horizon is supplied.

contract.note: Reading the statement as denying substantive implemented efficiency work is ordinary and fair. The contract appropriately avoids inventing a numerical meaning for the severity of inefficiency or treating the statement as denying every research attempt.

evidence.note: Meta documents implemented training infrastructure improvements before the post. This establishes substantive engineering activity; the reported magnitude remains a company claim.
Google documents distillation into a smaller Gemini model available in public preview, directly evidencing implemented efficiency work.
OpenAI documents a smaller released model and an improved tokenizer shared with GPT-4o. These evidence engineering effort without relying on API prices as production-cost measurements.

Anthropic describes deliberate compactness and speed tradeoffs, evidencing efficiency-oriented development. Haiku was forthcoming at this announcement; Sonnet was available. This does not independently establish resource savings.

reviews.rationale: The dated disclosures document substantive efficiency engineering before the post, contradicting the claimed absence of meaningful effort under the fair contract. They do not establish optimal efficiency or settle the unmeasured severity of remaining inefficiency. That limitation does not rescue the denial of effort.
